body: ## Pull request overview Improves Vulkan device creation diagnostics and adds resilience by retrying `vkCreateDevice` with progressively smaller extension sets when initialization fails. **Changes:** - Enhance `vkCreateDevice` failure logging to include the `VkResult` name and full requested extension list. - Add retry logic that removes non-essential extensions first, then falls back to a minimal required-extension set. - Extend `get_vulkan_result()` with additional missing `VkResult` string mappings. --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews. Learn how to get started.
